svg.title: Judging remote commands: newer, fresh, from this connection
svg.desc: The late packet arrives 0.3 seconds old and is rejected while the command is held for 0.3 seconds; in the outage the hold reaches 0.4 seconds at 5.4 seconds and the local PI takes over, changing the command by 0.026 points. Remote control returns only after the acknowledgement at 8.0 seconds, at 8.2 seconds. All six heaters peak at 35.999 degrees Celsius.
svg.text: Judging remote commands: newer, fresh, from this connection
Control Studio recording of this project · six heaters, each with one network fault after 5 s · numbers answer the predictions
Late: packet 50 arrives 0.3 s old and is rejected
Outage: 0.4 s without a packet → local PI from 5.4 s
Acknowledged at 8.0 s; remote again at 8.2 s
All six heaters: peak 35.999 °C, within 0.040 °C of 36 °C from 30 s
